name: Bridgewell Clap & Maracas
explanation: Modelled on the Roland TR-808 from its Service Notes; the same circuit model as inside Bridgewell 80, on its own so it gets its own mixer channel. The clap is band-passed noise through a sawtooth envelope that re-fires three times before the fourth ramp is left to decay, over a slower 'reverb' envelope — the multiple-hands sound. Maracas: short high-passed noise.
